FX-SOLIDC-001.says: The settings as they start, source opacity 100, colour #ffffff, opacity 100, normal: the drawing over white: the empty border turns white, the soft edges the line and the skin half over white, every solid pixel as it was.

FX-SOLIDC-002.says: Colour #3366cc: the drawing over a blue: the border turns #3366cc, every solid pixel as it was.

FX-SOLIDC-003.says: Colour #3366cc at opacity 50: the border is the blue at half covering, a soft edge covers three quarters, every solid pixel as it was.

FX-SOLIDC-004.says: Opacity 0: no solid at all: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SOLIDC-005.says: Source opacity 50 over the blue: the drawing at half strength over a solid blue, everything opaque.

FX-SOLIDC-006.says: Source opacity 0: the blue alone, every pixel #3366cc.

FX-SOLIDC-007.says: Add, colour #404040: every solid pixel raised by the grey (in linear light, held at the top): the black turns #404040, the white stays white; the border is the grey.

FX-SOLIDC-008.says: Screen, colour #808080: every solid pixel lightened, the black turns #808080, the white stays white; the border is the grey.

FX-SOLIDC-009.says: Multiply, colour #ff8040: every solid pixel darkened by the orange: the white turns #ff8040, the black stays black; the border is the orange.

FX-SOLIDC-010.says: Multiply, colour #ff8040 at opacity 60, source opacity 70: the drawing at 70 per cent multiplied with the orange at 60, where both show.

FX-SOLIDC-011.says: Colour #3366cc, opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing untouched, frame 2 FX-SOLIDC-003 (opacity 50), frame 4 FX-SOLIDC-002.

FX-SOLIDC-012.says: Colour #3366cc, source opacity eased from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: frame 0 FX-SOLIDC-006; at frame 2 it has gone past 100 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-SOLIDC-002.

FX-SOLIDC-013.says: FX-SOLIDC-007 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; the grey fills only the layer, so columns 0 to 2 of the frame stay empty.

FX-SOLIDC-014.says: Opacity 101: above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLIDC-015.says: Source opacity -1: below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLIDC-016.says: Blend "difference": this program's Solid Composite blends normal, add, screen or multiply. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLIDC-017.says: Colour "white": a colour is written #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLIDC-018.says: Colour "#12345": five digits. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SOLIDC-019.says: Opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
